data.label: include
data.reason_zh: 模块化 harness 依据成功/失败轨迹识别缺陷并演化各模块，集成后的 harness 在未见任务和不同模型上迁移，符合方法类 RSI 收录。

scope_support.feedback_quote: ModularRSI contrasts successful and failed trajectories for the same task and aggregates evidence across tasks to identify recurring behavioral deficiencies.
scope_support.object_quote: It decomposes the evolvable harness into five functional modules: Agent Loop, Tool Use, Observation Management, Context Management, and Task Completion Detection.
scope_support.persistence_quote: Experiments on TB2.0 and SWE-Bench Verified show consistent improvements on unseen in-domain and cross-domain tasks, with the evolved harness also transferring across different foundation models.
